verdict.rationale: Lindy presents itself as an AI employee/teammate agent, which makes it an MCP client rather than a server. Its MCP documentation describes only client-side use: pointing Lindy at hosted MCP servers so it can consume their tools. The probe's 'official MCP server' label points to that same client-side page, and nothing in the pack shows Lindy exposing its own workflows or actions as MCP tools for external agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can expose my workflows or connected app actions as MCP tools that an external agent can call
